content: (2) After replacing CNN with an LSTM layer, performance drops as much as INLINEFORM0 in accuracy and INLINEFORM1 in F1 score. The reason may be the redundancy of RNNs. AutoJudge has employed several GRU layers to encode text sequences. Another RNN layer may be useless to capture sequential dependencies, while CNN can catch the local structure in convolution windows.
